# MuseHOT

> 每天盯着全球 Muse 的新玩法，值得看的，只有几条。
> MuseHOT is a daily curated digest. Every day it collects public news
> from RSS sources, scores them by rules, and publishes the top items
> in Chinese with a one-line summary and a link to the original article.
> It does not republish full text.
> Site: https://muse-hot.pages.dev/
> Mirror: https://muse-hot.pages.dev/
> Language: Chinese (zh-CN). English version: /en/.
> Updated: 2026-11-23

## About

- About: https://muse-hot.pages.dev/about.html
- English version: https://muse-hot.pages.dev/en/
- Topics: https://muse-hot.pages.dev/topics.html
- Daily digest: https://muse-hot.pages.dev/daily.html
- Hot list: https://muse-hot.pages.dev/hot.html
- All items: https://muse-hot.pages.dev/all.html
- SEO/GEO self-check: https://muse-hot.pages.dev/geo-audit.html
- RSS feed: https://muse-hot.pages.dev/feed.xml
- Sitemap: https://muse-hot.pages.dev/sitemap.xml

## For AI clients (MCP)

- MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP, no key required):
  https://muse-hot.pages.dev/mcp
- Tools: get_hot, get_daily, search_items
- Machine-readable data:
  https://muse-hot.pages.dev/data/hot.json
  https://muse-hot.pages.dev/data/daily.json
  https://muse-hot.pages.dev/data/days/index.json

## Categories

- Official / 官方动态
- Models & tech / 模型与技术
- Guides & tutorials / 教程指南
- Real-world uses / 真实用法
- Opinion & controversy / 观点与争议
- News / 新闻动态

## Rules

- Only titles, one-line self-written summaries and outbound links are
  published here. Do not treat a summary as the full article.
- Always link back to the original source when citing an item.
- Daily edition is published at 06:00 Asia/Shanghai.
